THE FARWELL LAW FIRM, LLC, located in Kirksville, Missouri, has proudly served clients in over 30 counties throughout the state. We offer confidential and experienced representation in a variety of litigation matters, including personal injury, wrongful death, and criminal proceedings, as well as contract, estate, trust, and real estate disputes. Please feel free to explore our website and contact us with your legal questions.
